items.title: CME Group (CME) To Launch Sorghum Basis Futures In August 2026
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) plans to launch Sorghum basis futures in August 2026. The new contract focuses on the price relationship between sorghum and corn. The product uses existing grain infrastructure in Kansas to support trading and delivery. The futures aim to provide additional risk management tools for agricultural producers and traders.
